Keyboard Shortcuts

Symbols

∑ : Type “sum”

π : Type “pi”

θ : Type “theta”

√ : Type “sqrt”
Type “nthroot” for cubed roots, etc
 
∏ : Type “prod”

View all of the keyboard shortcuts by clicking the 
“keyboard shortcuts” link in the help menu.

Open Graph: ctrl + o

Save: ctrl + s

Save-As or Rename: ctrl + shift + s

Undo: ctrl + z

Redo: ctrl + y

New expression: Press “enter”

Move up/down: Press the   and    arrow keys  

Move left/right: Press the        and        arrow keys

Add a new text box: Press the quotation keys (“ ”)

Delete an expression: Press “delete”
